name: @altopelago/aes
description: Reference implementations and development material for AES, Telex v1, and the Film v1 draft

scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --check --manifest-path implementations/rust/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --manifest-path implementations/rust/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings
scripts.test:film: node --test test/film-conformance.test.js test/film-decoder.test.js test/film-decoder-conformance.test.js && cargo test --locked --manifest-path implementations/rust/Cargo.toml --test film --test film_api --test film_conformance
scripts.public:check: npm run precommit && npm test && npm run check:rust && npm run test:rust && npm run validate:cts-claims && npm run test:conformance:shared && npm run test:conformance:rust:shared
